zones.name: Brain
zones.effect: Thumb tip and pad. Pressed for headache, dizziness and poor sleep.
zones.effectZh: 拇指末节指腹。按压用于头痛、头晕、失眠。

zones.name: Pituitary
zones.effect: Center of the thumb pad. Said to balance hormones.
zones.effectZh: 拇指指腹正中。传统认为可调节内分泌。

zones.name: Frontal sinuses
zones.effect: Pads of the four finger tips. For a blocked nose, sinus pressure, frontal headache.
zones.effectZh: 四指末节指腹。用于鼻塞、鼻窦胀痛、前额头痛。

zones.name: Teeth & jaw
zones.effect: Middle sections of the four fingers. Traditionally for toothache and jaw tension.
zones.effectZh: 四指中节掌面。传统用于牙痛、下颌紧张。

zones.name: Eyes
zones.effect: Base sections of the index and middle fingers. For tired, strained eyes.
zones.effectZh: 食指、中指近节掌面。用于眼疲劳、干涩。

zones.name: Ears
zones.effect: Base sections of the ring and little fingers. For ringing ears and ear ache.
zones.effectZh: 无名指、小指近节掌面。用于耳鸣、耳痛。

zones.name: Neck & throat
zones.effect: Base section of the thumb. For a stiff neck and a scratchy throat.
zones.effectZh: 拇指近节。用于颈项僵硬、咽喉不适。

zones.name: Thyroid
zones.effect: Curved band from the thumb mound up to the thumb web. Said to regulate metabolism.
zones.effectZh: 大鱼际至虎口的弧形带。传统认为可调节代谢。

zones.name: Spine
zones.effect: Outer edge of the thumb and its mound, down to the wrist. For back and neck ache.
zones.effectZh: 拇指及大鱼际桡侧缘至腕。用于颈背腰痛。

zones.name: Lungs & bronchi
zones.effect: Pads just below the fingers, index to little. For coughs and chest tightness.
zones.effectZh: 四指根下方的掌垫横带。用于咳嗽、胸闷。

zones.name: Shoulder
zones.effect: Little-finger edge at the knuckle. For stiff shoulders.
zones.effectZh: 第5掌指关节尺侧。用于肩部僵硬酸痛。

zones.name: Arm & elbow
zones.effect: Little-finger edge of the palm, below the shoulder. For elbow and arm strain.
zones.effectZh: 手掌尺侧缘，肩区下方。用于肘臂劳损。

zones.name: Hip & knee
zones.effect: Little-finger edge of the lower palm. For hip and knee stiffness.
zones.effectZh: 手掌尺侧缘下部。用于髋、膝僵硬。

zones.name: Solar plexus
zones.effect: Center of the upper palm. Pressed to calm nerves and a tight stomach.
zones.effectZh: 掌心上部正中。按压用于缓解紧张、胃部痉挛。

zones.name: Heart
zones.effect: Left hand only, below the ring and little fingers. For palpitations and restlessness.
zones.effectZh: 仅左手，无名指、小指下方。用于心悸、心烦。

zones.name: Spleen
zones.effect: Left hand only, below the heart zone. TCM spleen: appetite, digestion, fatigue.
zones.effectZh: 仅左手，心反射区下方。中医之脾：食欲、消化、乏力。

zones.name: Liver
zones.effect: Right hand only, below the ring and little fingers. Said to support detox and ease irritability.
zones.effectZh: 仅右手，无名指、小指下方。传统认为可助肝排毒、平肝除烦。

zones.name: Gallbladder
zones.effect: Right hand only, inside the lower liver zone. For a bitter taste and fatty-food discomfort.
zones.effectZh: 仅右手，肝反射区下部之中。用于口苦、油腻后不适。

zones.name: Stomach
zones.effect: Upper palm on the thumb side. For indigestion and bloating.
zones.effectZh: 掌心上部桡侧。用于消化不良、胃胀。

zones.name: Pancreas
zones.effect: Below the stomach zone. Traditionally linked to blood sugar.
zones.effectZh: 胃反射区下方。传统上与血糖调节相关。

zones.name: Duodenum
zones.effect: Below the pancreas zone. For stomach ache after meals.
zones.effectZh: 胰反射区下方。用于餐后胃痛、腹胀。

zones.name: Adrenals
zones.effect: Just above the kidney zone, center palm. Traditionally for inflammation and allergy.
zones.effectZh: 掌心肾反射区上方。传统用于炎症、过敏。

zones.name: Kidneys
zones.effect: Center of the palm. For fatigue and lower-back ache.
zones.effectZh: 掌心正中。用于疲劳、腰酸。

zones.name: Ureter
zones.effect: Line from the kidney zone to the bladder. For urinary discomfort.
zones.effectZh: 肾至膀胱的斜线。用于排尿不畅。

zones.name: Bladder
zones.effect: Where the thumb mound meets the lower palm, above the wrist. For frequent urination.
zones.effectZh: 大鱼际与掌根交界处。用于尿频。

zones.name: Transverse colon
zones.effect: Band across the lower-middle palm. For constipation and wind.
zones.effectZh: 掌中下部横带。用于便秘、腹胀。

zones.name: Ascending colon
zones.effect: Right hand only, little-finger side of the lower palm. For constipation.
zones.effectZh: 仅右手，掌下部尺侧纵带。用于便秘。

zones.name: Appendix & ileocecal valve
zones.effect: Right hand only, bottom of the ascending colon. Traditionally for lower-right bloating.
zones.effectZh: 仅右手，升结肠下端。传统用于右下腹胀。

zones.name: Descending & sigmoid colon
zones.effect: Left hand only, down the little-finger side then across above the wrist. For constipation.
zones.effectZh: 仅左手，掌下部尺侧下行再横过腕上。用于便秘。

zones.name: Rectum
zones.effect: Left hand only, low center of the palm. For constipation and piles.
zones.effectZh: 仅左手，掌根正中。用于便秘、痔疮。

zones.name: Small intestine
zones.effect: Lower palm, framed by the colon. For poor absorption.
zones.effectZh: 掌下部，结肠环绕之中。用于消化吸收不良。

zones.name: Uterus / prostate
zones.effect: Thumb side of the wrist crease. For menstrual cramps or prostate discomfort.
zones.effectZh: 腕横纹桡侧。用于痛经或前列腺不适。

zones.name: Reproductive glands
zones.effect: Middle of the wrist crease. For menstrual discomfort.
zones.effectZh: 腕横纹中部。用于经期不适。

zones.name: Throat & trachea
zones.effect: Back of the thumb's base section. For sore throat and cough.
zones.effectZh: 拇指近节背面。用于咽痛、咳嗽。

zones.name: Head & neck lymph
zones.effect: Webs between the fingers. Traditionally for swollen glands and colds.
zones.effectZh: 各指间指蹼根部。传统用于淋巴结肿大、感冒。

zones.name: Upper back & shoulders
zones.effect: Just behind the knuckles. For tight shoulders and upper back.
zones.effectZh: 掌指关节后方横带。用于肩背紧张。

zones.name: Chest & breast
zones.effect: Upper back of the hand over metacarpals 2–4. For chest tightness.
zones.effectZh: 手背第2–4掌骨远段。用于胸闷。

zones.name: Diaphragm
zones.effect: Band across the middle of the back of the hand. For hiccups and shallow breathing.
zones.effectZh: 手背中部横带。用于打嗝、呼吸短浅。

zones.name: Ribs
zones.effect: Hollows between metacarpals 2–3 and 4–5. For rib-side ache.
zones.effectZh: 第2、3及第4、5掌骨间凹陷。用于胁肋酸痛。

zones.name: Cervical spine
zones.effect: Outer edge of the thumb. For neck stiffness.
zones.effectZh: 拇指桡侧缘。用于颈椎僵硬。

zones.name: Thoracic spine
zones.effect: Thumb-side edge, upper metacarpal. For upper-back ache.
zones.effectZh: 手背桡侧缘，第1掌骨上段。用于胸背酸痛。

zones.name: Lumbar spine
zones.effect: Thumb-side edge, lower metacarpal. For lower-back ache.
zones.effectZh: 手背桡侧缘，第1掌骨下段。用于腰痛。

zones.name: Sacrum & coccyx
zones.effect: Thumb-side edge at the wrist. For tailbone and sciatic pain.
zones.effectZh: 手背桡侧缘近腕处。用于骶尾痛、坐骨神经痛。

zones.name: Shoulder joint
zones.effect: Little-finger edge at the knuckle. For shoulder ache.
zones.effectZh: 第5掌指关节尺侧。用于肩痛。

zones.name: Elbow
zones.effect: Little-finger edge, middle of metacarpal 5. For elbow strain.
zones.effectZh: 第5掌骨尺侧中部。用于肘部劳损。

zones.name: Knee
zones.effect: Little-finger edge, lower metacarpal 5. For knee ache.
zones.effectZh: 第5掌骨尺侧下段。用于膝痛。

zones.name: Hip
zones.effect: Little-finger edge at the wrist. For hip ache.
zones.effectZh: 腕背尺侧缘。用于髋痛。

zones.name: Upper-body lymph
zones.effect: Hollow on the little-finger side of the back of the wrist. Traditionally for fever and swelling.
zones.effectZh: 腕背尺侧凹陷。传统用于发热、肿胀。

zones.name: Lower-body lymph
zones.effect: Hollow on the thumb side of the back of the wrist. Traditionally for leg swelling.
zones.effectZh: 腕背桡侧凹陷。传统用于下肢水肿。

zones.name: Groin & fallopian tubes
zones.effect: Across the back of the wrist. Traditionally for groin and pelvic discomfort.
zones.effectZh: 腕背横带。传统用于腹股沟、盆腔不适。

zones.name: Hegu (LI4)
zones.effect: Between metacarpals 1 and 2, level with the middle of the 2nd. The classic point for headache, toothache and face pain. Avoid in pregnancy.
zones.effectZh: 第1、2掌骨间，第2掌骨中点桡侧。头痛、牙痛、面痛常用穴。孕妇忌按。

zones.name: Luozhen (EX-UE8)
zones.effect: Between metacarpals 2 and 3, just behind the knuckles. Press while slowly turning the head for a stiff neck.
zones.effectZh: 第2、3掌骨间，掌指关节后。落枕时边按边缓慢转头。

zones.name: Zhongzhu (SJ3)
zones.effect: Between metacarpals 4 and 5, behind the knuckles. For ringing ears and one-sided headache.
zones.effectZh: 第4、5掌骨间，掌指关节后。用于耳鸣、偏头痛。

zones.name: Yemen (SJ2)
zones.effect: Web between ring and little fingers. For sore throat and ear problems.
zones.effectZh: 无名指与小指指蹼缘。用于咽喉肿痛、耳病。

zones.name: Houxi (SI3)
zones.effect: Little-finger edge, behind the knuckle. For stiff neck and upper-back pain.
zones.effectZh: 小指尺侧，第5掌指关节后。用于颈项强痛、上背痛。

zones.name: Yaotongdian (EX-UE7)
zones.effect: Two points between metacarpals 2–3 and 4–5, halfway to the wrist. For acute low-back strain.
zones.effectZh: 第2、3及第4、5掌骨间，掌指关节与腕横纹中点。用于急性腰扭伤。

zones.name: Yangxi (LI5)
zones.effect: Thumb end of the wrist crease, in the hollow. For wrist pain, headache and toothache.
zones.effectZh: 腕背横纹桡侧凹陷中。用于腕痛、头痛、牙痛。

zones.name: Yangchi (SJ4)
zones.effect: Middle of the back wrist crease, little-finger side. For wrist pain and cold hands.
zones.effectZh: 腕背横纹中，指伸肌腱尺侧凹陷。用于腕痛、手足怕冷。

zones.name: Waiguan (SJ5)
zones.effect: Two thumb-widths above the wrist crease, between the forearm bones. For headache, ear and wrist pain.
zones.effectZh: 腕背横纹上2寸，尺桡骨之间。用于头痛、耳病、腕痛。

zones.name: Ear apex (HX6,7i)
zones.effect: Top of the helix. Traditionally pricked to bring down fever and high blood pressure.
zones.effectZh: 耳轮顶端。传统点刺用于退热、降压。

zones.name: Ear center (HX1)
zones.effect: The helix root crossing the bowl. Traditionally for hiccups and itchy skin.
zones.effectZh: 耳轮脚。传统用于呃逆、皮肤瘙痒。

zones.name: Rectum (HX2)
zones.effect: Helix just above its root. For constipation and piles.
zones.effectZh: 耳轮脚上方的耳轮。用于便秘、痔疮。

zones.name: Urethra (HX3)
zones.effect: Helix level with the lower bowl. For frequent or urgent urination.
zones.effectZh: 直肠区上方的耳轮。用于尿频、尿急。

zones.name: External genitals (HX4)
zones.effect: Helix level with the inferior crus. Traditionally for genital itching and discomfort.
zones.effectZh: 与对耳轮下脚相对的耳轮。传统用于外阴瘙痒、不适。

zones.name: Anus (HX5)
zones.effect: Helix level with the triangular fossa. For piles and anal discomfort.
zones.effectZh: 与三角窝相对的耳轮。用于痔疮、肛门不适。

zones.name: Helix 1–4 (HX9–12)
zones.effect: Back rim of the helix down to the lobe. Traditionally pricked for fever and sore throat.
zones.effectZh: 耳轮后缘至耳垂。传统点刺用于发热、咽痛。

zones.name: Finger (SF1)
zones.effect: Top of the scapha. For finger pain and numbness.
zones.effectZh: 耳舟上部。用于手指疼痛、麻木。

zones.name: Wind stream (SF1,2i)
zones.effect: Between the finger and wrist areas. Traditionally for hives, hay fever and itch.
zones.effectZh: 指区与腕区之间。传统用于荨麻疹、过敏性鼻炎、瘙痒。

zones.name: Wrist (SF2)
zones.effect: Upper scapha, below the finger area. For wrist pain.
zones.effectZh: 耳舟指区下方。用于腕部疼痛。

zones.name: Elbow (SF3)
zones.effect: Middle of the scapha. For elbow and arm pain.
zones.effectZh: 耳舟中部。用于肘臂疼痛。

zones.name: Shoulder (SF4,5)
zones.effect: Lower scapha. For stiff or frozen shoulder.
zones.effectZh: 耳舟下部。用于肩周炎、肩痛。

zones.name: Clavicle (SF6)
zones.effect: Bottom of the scapha. For collarbone and shoulder ache.
zones.effectZh: 耳舟最下部。用于锁骨、肩部酸痛。

zones.name: Heel (AH1)
zones.effect: Front tip of the superior crus. For heel pain.
zones.effectZh: 对耳轮上脚前上部。用于足跟痛。

zones.name: Toe (AH2)
zones.effect: Back tip of the superior crus. For toe pain.
zones.effectZh: 对耳轮上脚后上部。用于足趾疼痛。

zones.name: Ankle (AH3)
zones.effect: Superior crus, below heel and toe. For ankle sprain and pain.
zones.effectZh: 对耳轮上脚，跟、趾区下方。用于踝关节扭伤、疼痛。

zones.name: Knee (AH4)
zones.effect: Middle third of the superior crus. For knee pain.
zones.effectZh: 对耳轮上脚中1/3。用于膝关节疼痛。

zones.name: Hip (AH5)
zones.effect: Lower third of the superior crus. For hip pain.
zones.effectZh: 对耳轮上脚下1/3。用于髋关节疼痛。

zones.name: Sciatic nerve (AH6)
zones.effect: Front two-thirds of the inferior crus. For sciatica.
zones.effectZh: 对耳轮下脚前2/3。用于坐骨神经痛。

zones.name: Sympathetic (AH6a)
zones.effect: Front tip of the inferior crus, under the helix. For spasms, palpitations, stomach cramps.
zones.effectZh: 对耳轮下脚前端与耳轮内缘交界处。用于胃肠痉挛、心悸。

zones.name: Gluteal (AH7)
zones.effect: Back third of the inferior crus. For buttock and sciatic pain.
zones.effectZh: 对耳轮下脚后1/3。用于臀部疼痛、坐骨神经痛。

zones.name: Abdomen (AH8)
zones.effect: Upper antihelix body, bowl side. For bloating and period pain.
zones.effectZh: 对耳轮体前部上2/5。用于腹胀、痛经。

zones.name: Lumbosacral spine (AH9)
zones.effect: Upper antihelix body, behind the abdomen area. For low-back pain.
zones.effectZh: 腹区后方。用于腰骶痛。

zones.name: Chest (AH10)
zones.effect: Middle antihelix body, bowl side. For chest tightness and rib-side pain.
zones.effectZh: 对耳轮体前部中2/5。用于胸闷、胸胁痛。

zones.name: Thoracic spine (AH11)
zones.effect: Middle antihelix body, behind the chest area. For upper-back pain.
zones.effectZh: 胸区后方。用于胸背痛。

zones.name: Neck (AH12)
zones.effect: Lower antihelix body, bowl side. For a stiff neck.
zones.effectZh: 对耳轮体前部下1/5。用于落枕、颈项强痛。

zones.name: Cervical spine (AH13)
zones.effect: Lower antihelix body, behind the neck area. For neck pain.
zones.effectZh: 颈区后方。用于颈椎病、落枕。

zones.name: Superior triangular fossa (TF1)
zones.effect: Front-upper triangular fossa. Traditionally for high blood pressure.
zones.effectZh: 三角窝前1/3上部。传统用于高血压。

zones.name: Internal genitals (TF2)
zones.effect: Front-lower triangular fossa. For menstrual problems.
zones.effectZh: 三角窝前1/3下部。用于月经不调、痛经。

zones.name: Middle triangular fossa (TF3)
zones.effect: Middle third of the triangular fossa. Traditionally for wheezing and cough.
zones.effectZh: 三角窝中1/3。传统用于哮喘、咳嗽。

zones.name: Shenmen (TF4)
zones.effect: Back-upper triangular fossa. The calming point: stress, anxiety, poor sleep, pain.
zones.effectZh: 三角窝后1/3上部。安神要穴：压力、焦虑、失眠、疼痛。

zones.name: Pelvis (TF5)
zones.effect: Back-lower triangular fossa. For pelvic and lower-abdominal pain.
zones.effectZh: 三角窝后1/3下部。用于盆腔炎、下腹痛。

zones.name: Upper tragus (TG1)
zones.effect: Upper half of the tragus, outer face. Traditionally for sore throat and a blocked nose.
zones.effectZh: 耳屏外侧面上1/2。传统用于咽炎、鼻塞。

zones.name: Lower tragus (TG2)
zones.effect: Lower half of the tragus, outer face. Traditionally for a runny nose.
zones.effectZh: 耳屏外侧面下1/2。传统用于鼻炎、流涕。

zones.name: Tragus apex (TG1p)
zones.effect: Upper tip of the tragus. Traditionally pricked for fever and toothache.
zones.effectZh: 耳屏游离缘上部尖端。传统点刺用于发热、牙痛。

zones.name: External nose (TG1,2i)
zones.effect: Middle of the tragus, outer face. For a blocked or runny nose.
zones.effectZh: 耳屏外侧面中部。用于鼻塞、流涕。

zones.name: Adrenal (TG2p)
zones.effect: Lower tip of the tragus. Traditionally for inflammation, allergy and low blood pressure.
zones.effectZh: 耳屏游离缘下部尖端。传统用于炎症、过敏、低血压。

zones.name: Throat (TG3)
zones.effect: Inner face of the tragus, upper half. For sore throat and hoarseness.
zones.effectZh: 耳屏内侧面上1/2。用于咽痛、声音嘶哑。

zones.name: Internal nose (TG4)
zones.effect: Inner face of the tragus, lower half. For a blocked nose and sinus pressure.
zones.effectZh: 耳屏内侧面下1/2。用于鼻塞、鼻窦炎。

zones.name: Forehead (AT1)
zones.effect: Front of the antitragus. For frontal headache and dizziness.
zones.effectZh: 对耳屏外侧面前部。用于前额痛、头晕。

zones.name: Temple (AT2)
zones.effect: Middle of the antitragus. For one-sided headache.
zones.effectZh: 对耳屏外侧面中部。用于偏头痛。

zones.name: Occiput (AT3)
zones.effect: Back of the antitragus. For back-of-head pain and dizziness.
zones.effectZh: 对耳屏外侧面后部。用于后头痛、眩晕。

zones.name: Subcortex (AT4)
zones.effect: Inner face of the antitragus. For pain, poor sleep and nervous tension.
zones.effectZh: 对耳屏内侧面。用于疼痛、失眠、神经紧张。

zones.name: Antitragus apex (AT1,2,4i)
zones.effect: Tip of the antitragus. Traditionally for wheezing and mumps.
zones.effectZh: 对耳屏游离缘尖端。传统用于哮喘、腮腺炎。

zones.name: Brainstem (AT3,4i)
zones.effect: Notch between the antitragus and antihelix. Traditionally for dizziness and headache.
zones.effectZh: 轮屏切迹处。传统用于眩晕、头痛。

zones.name: Mouth (CO1)
zones.effect: Under the front of the helix root, by the ear canal. For mouth ulcers and facial twitching.
zones.effectZh: 耳轮脚下方前1/3，近外耳门。用于口腔溃疡、面肌痉挛。

zones.name: Esophagus (CO2)
zones.effect: Under the middle of the helix root. For a lump-in-the-throat feeling and heartburn.
zones.effectZh: 耳轮脚下方中1/3。用于梅核气、烧心。

zones.name: Cardia (CO3)
zones.effect: Under the back of the helix root. For nausea and acid.
zones.effectZh: 耳轮脚下方后1/3。用于恶心、反酸。

zones.name: Stomach (CO4)
zones.effect: Where the helix root ends. For stomach ache, nausea, acid.
zones.effectZh: 耳轮脚消失处。用于胃痛、恶心、反酸。

zones.name: Duodenum (CO5)
zones.effect: Above the helix root, back third. For duodenal ulcer pain.
zones.effectZh: 耳轮脚上方后1/3。用于十二指肠溃疡疼痛。

zones.name: Small intestine (CO6)
zones.effect: Above the helix root, middle third. For poor digestion.
zones.effectZh: 耳轮脚上方中1/3。用于消化不良。

zones.name: Large intestine (CO7)
zones.effect: Above the helix root, front third. For constipation.
zones.effectZh: 耳轮脚上方前1/3。用于便秘、腹泻。

zones.name: Appendix (CO6,7i)
zones.effect: Between the small and large intestine areas. Traditionally for lower-right belly pain.
zones.effectZh: 小肠区与大肠区之间。传统用于右下腹痛。

zones.name: Angle of cymba (CO8)
zones.effect: Front corner of the upper bowl, under the inferior crus. Traditionally for prostate trouble.
zones.effectZh: 对耳轮下脚下方前部。传统用于前列腺不适。

zones.name: Bladder (CO9)
zones.effect: Upper bowl under the inferior crus, middle. For frequent urination.
zones.effectZh: 对耳轮下脚下方中部。用于尿频、尿急。

zones.name: Ureter (CO9,10i)
zones.effect: Between the bladder and kidney areas. For urinary discomfort.
zones.effectZh: 膀胱区与肾区之间。用于排尿不畅。

zones.name: Kidney (CO10)
zones.effect: Upper bowl under the inferior crus, back. For fatigue, low back ache, ringing ears.
zones.effectZh: 对耳轮下脚下方后部。用于疲劳、腰酸、耳鸣。

zones.name: Pancreas & gallbladder (CO11)
zones.effect: Back-upper cymba. For indigestion and a bitter taste.
zones.effectZh: 耳甲艇后上部。用于消化不良、口苦。

zones.name: Liver (CO12)
zones.effect: Back-lower cymba. For irritability, tired or dry eyes.
zones.effectZh: 耳甲艇后下部。用于烦躁易怒、眼睛干涩疲劳。

zones.name: Spleen (CO13)
zones.effect: Back-upper cavum. TCM spleen: appetite, digestion, fatigue.
zones.effectZh: 耳甲腔后上部。中医之脾：食欲、消化、乏力。

zones.name: Heart (CO15)
zones.effect: Center of the cavum. For palpitations and restless sleep.
zones.effectZh: 耳甲腔正中凹陷处。用于心悸、心烦失眠。

zones.name: Trachea (CO16)
zones.effect: Between the heart area and the ear canal. For cough.
zones.effectZh: 心区与外耳门之间。用于咳嗽、气喘。

zones.name: Lung (CO14)
zones.effect: Around the heart and trachea areas. For cough; traditionally also skin and quitting smoking.
zones.effectZh: 心、气管区周围。用于咳嗽，传统亦用于皮肤病、戒烟。

zones.name: Sanjiao (CO17)
zones.effect: Bottom of the cavum, behind the canal. TCM water passages: bloating, swelling.
zones.effectZh: 外耳门后下方。中医三焦：腹胀、水肿。

zones.name: Endocrine (CO18)
zones.effect: Inside the notch below the tragus. Said to regulate hormones.
zones.effectZh: 屏间切迹内，耳甲腔底部。传统认为可调节内分泌。

zones.name: Teeth (LO1)
zones.effect: Lobe square 1. For toothache.
zones.effectZh: 耳垂1区。用于牙痛。

zones.name: Tongue (LO2)
zones.effect: Lobe square 2. Traditionally for tongue and mouth sores.
zones.effectZh: 耳垂2区。传统用于舌炎、口腔溃疡。

zones.name: Jaw (LO3)
zones.effect: Lobe square 3. For toothache and jaw joint pain.
zones.effectZh: 耳垂3区。用于牙痛、颞颌关节痛。

zones.name: Anterior ear lobe (LO4)
zones.effect: Lobe square 4. Traditionally for toothache and restless sleep.
zones.effectZh: 耳垂4区。传统用于牙痛、神经衰弱。

zones.name: Eye (LO5)
zones.effect: Center square of the lobe. For tired, red or dry eyes.
zones.effectZh: 耳垂5区正中。用于眼疲劳、红肿、干涩。

zones.name: Inner ear (LO6)
zones.effect: Lobe square 6. For ringing ears and dizziness.
zones.effectZh: 耳垂6区。用于耳鸣、眩晕。

zones.name: Cheek (LO5,6i)
zones.effect: Between the eye and inner-ear squares. For facial pain and acne.
zones.effectZh: 耳垂眼区与内耳区之间。用于面痛、痤疮。

zones.name: Tonsil (LO7,8,9)
zones.effect: Bottom row of the lobe. For swollen tonsils and sore throat.
zones.effectZh: 耳垂7、8、9区。用于扁桃体肿痛、咽痛。

zones.name: Brain
zones.effect: Big-toe pad (left foot ↔ right brain). For headache, dizziness, poor sleep.
zones.effectZh: 拇趾趾腹（左脚对应右脑）。用于头痛、头晕、失眠。

zones.name: Pituitary
zones.effect: Center of the big-toe pad. Said to balance hormones.
zones.effectZh: 拇趾趾腹正中。传统认为可调节内分泌。

zones.name: Cerebellum & brainstem
zones.effect: Lower outer part of the big-toe pad. Traditionally for balance and dizziness.
zones.effectZh: 拇趾趾腹外侧下部。传统用于平衡失调、眩晕。

zones.name: Trigeminal nerve
zones.effect: Upper outer edge of the big-toe pad. For face and one-sided head pain.
zones.effectZh: 拇趾趾腹外侧上部。用于面痛、偏头痛。

zones.name: Nose
zones.effect: Inner edge of the big-toe pad. For a blocked or runny nose.
zones.effectZh: 拇趾趾腹内侧缘。用于鼻塞、流涕。

zones.name: Frontal sinuses
zones.effect: Pads of toes 2–5. For a blocked nose and frontal headache.
zones.effectZh: 第2–5趾趾腹。用于鼻塞、前额头痛。

zones.name: Eyes
zones.effect: Base of toes 2 and 3. For tired, strained eyes.
zones.effectZh: 第2、3趾根部。用于眼疲劳。

zones.name: Ears
zones.effect: Base of toes 4 and 5. For ringing ears.
zones.effectZh: 第4、5趾根部。用于耳鸣。

zones.name: Neck
zones.effect: Base of the big toe. For a stiff neck.
zones.effectZh: 拇趾根部。用于颈项僵硬。

zones.name: Thyroid
zones.effect: Ball of the big toe. Said to regulate metabolism.
zones.effectZh: 拇趾球部（第1跖骨头）。传统认为可调节代谢。

zones.name: Parathyroid
zones.effect: Inner edge of the big-toe joint. Traditionally for cramps and calcium balance.
zones.effectZh: 第1跖趾关节内侧。传统用于抽筋、钙质平衡。

zones.name: Cervical spine
zones.effect: Inner edge of the big toe. The spine runs down the inner arch. For neck pain.
zones.effectZh: 拇趾内侧缘，脊柱沿足弓内侧分布。用于颈痛。

zones.name: Thoracic spine
zones.effect: Inner edge along the first metatarsal. For upper-back ache.
zones.effectZh: 足内侧缘，沿第1跖骨。用于胸背酸痛。

zones.name: Lumbar spine
zones.effect: Inner edge of the arch. For lower-back pain.
zones.effectZh: 足弓内侧缘。用于腰痛。

zones.name: Sacrum & coccyx
zones.effect: Inner edge of the heel. For tailbone and sciatic pain.
zones.effectZh: 足跟内侧缘。用于骶尾痛、坐骨神经痛。

zones.name: Trapezius
zones.effect: Band just below toes 2–5. For tight shoulders.
zones.effectZh: 第2–5趾根下方横带。用于肩颈紧张。

zones.name: Lungs & bronchi
zones.effect: Ball of the foot under toes 2–5. For cough and chest tightness.
zones.effectZh: 第2–5趾下方的前脚掌。用于咳嗽、胸闷。

zones.name: Shoulder
zones.effect: Outer edge at the little-toe joint. For stiff shoulders.
zones.effectZh: 第5跖趾关节外侧。用于肩部僵硬。

zones.name: Elbow
zones.effect: Outer edge at the bump of metatarsal 5. For elbow strain.
zones.effectZh: 足外侧缘第5跖骨粗隆处。用于肘部劳损。

zones.name: Knee
zones.effect: Outer edge in front of the heel. For knee ache.
zones.effectZh: 足外侧缘足跟前方。用于膝痛。

zones.name: Solar plexus
zones.effect: Just below the ball, in the middle. Pressed to calm nerves and a knotted stomach.
zones.effectZh: 前脚掌下方正中。按压用于缓解紧张、胃部痉挛。

zones.name: Heart
zones.effect: Left foot only, under the ball below toes 4–5. For palpitations.
zones.effectZh: 仅左脚，第4、5趾下方前脚掌之后。用于心悸。

zones.name: Spleen
zones.effect: Left foot only, below the heart zone. TCM spleen: appetite, digestion.
zones.effectZh: 仅左脚，心反射区下方。中医之脾：食欲、消化。

zones.name: Liver
zones.effect: Right foot only, under the ball below toes 4–5. Said to support detox.
zones.effectZh: 仅右脚，第4、5趾下方前脚掌之后。传统认为可助肝排毒。

zones.name: Gallbladder
zones.effect: Right foot only, inside the lower liver zone. For a bitter taste and fatty-food discomfort.
zones.effectZh: 仅右脚，肝反射区下部之中。用于口苦、油腻后不适。

zones.name: Stomach
zones.effect: Below the ball of the big toe. For indigestion and bloating.
zones.effectZh: 拇趾球下方。用于消化不良、胃胀。

zones.name: Pancreas
zones.effect: Below the stomach zone. Traditionally linked to blood sugar.
zones.effectZh: 胃反射区下方。传统上与血糖调节相关。

zones.name: Duodenum
zones.effect: Below the pancreas zone. For stomach ache after meals.
zones.effectZh: 胰反射区下方。用于餐后胃痛。

zones.name: Adrenals
zones.effect: Just above the kidney zone. For inflammation and allergy.
zones.effectZh: 肾反射区上方。用于炎症、过敏。

zones.name: Yongquan (KI1)
zones.effect: Hollow at the front third of the sole when the toes curl. Grounding point: insomnia, dizziness, hot feet.
zones.effectZh: 足底前1/3凹陷处（卷足时）。用于失眠、头晕、足心发热。

zones.name: Kidneys
zones.effect: Middle of the sole. For fatigue and lower-back ache.
zones.effectZh: 足底中部。用于疲劳、腰酸。

zones.name: Ureter
zones.effect: Line from the kidney zone down to the bladder. For urinary discomfort.
zones.effectZh: 肾至膀胱的斜线带。用于排尿不畅。

zones.name: Bladder
zones.effect: Inner edge where the arch meets the heel. For frequent urination.
zones.effectZh: 足底内侧，足弓与足跟交界处。用于尿频。

zones.name: Transverse colon
zones.effect: Band across the middle of the sole. For constipation and wind.
zones.effectZh: 足底中部横带。用于便秘、腹胀。

zones.name: Ascending colon
zones.effect: Right foot only, outer edge of the arch. For constipation.
zones.effectZh: 仅右脚，足弓外侧纵带。用于便秘。

zones.name: Appendix & ileocecal valve
zones.effect: Right foot only, bottom of the ascending colon, in front of the heel. Traditionally for lower-right bloating.
zones.effectZh: 仅右脚，升结肠下端，足跟前方。传统用于右下腹胀。

zones.name: Descending & sigmoid colon
zones.effect: Left foot only, down the outer arch then across in front of the heel. For constipation.
zones.effectZh: 仅左脚，足弓外侧下行再横过足跟前方。用于便秘。

zones.name: Rectum
zones.effect: Left foot only, inner end of the sigmoid band. For constipation and piles.
zones.effectZh: 仅左脚，乙状结肠带内侧端。用于便秘、痔疮。

zones.name: Small intestine
zones.effect: Lower arch, framed by the colon. For poor absorption.
zones.effectZh: 足弓下部，结肠环绕之中。用于消化吸收不良。

zones.name: Sciatic nerve
zones.effect: Band across the front of the heel. For sciatic and leg pain.
zones.effectZh: 足跟前缘横带。用于坐骨神经痛、腿痛。

zones.name: Insomnia point
zones.effect: Front of the heel pad, center. For poor sleep.
zones.effectZh: 足跟前部正中。用于失眠。

zones.name: Reproductive glands
zones.effect: Center of the heel. For menstrual discomfort.
zones.effectZh: 足跟正中。用于经期不适。

zones.name: Upper jaw
zones.effect: Top of the big toe, just past the joint crease. For toothache and gum ache.
zones.effectZh: 拇趾背面，趾间关节横纹前方。用于牙痛、牙龈痛。

zones.name: Lower jaw
zones.effect: Top of the big toe, just behind the joint crease. For jaw tension and toothache.
zones.effectZh: 拇趾背面，趾间关节横纹后方。用于下颌紧张、牙痛。

zones.name: Tonsils
zones.effect: Top of the big toe's base, either side of the tendon. For sore throat.
zones.effectZh: 拇趾近节背面，肌腱两侧。用于咽喉肿痛。

zones.name: Throat & trachea
zones.effect: Top of the big-toe joint. For sore throat, hoarseness and cough.
zones.effectZh: 第1跖趾关节背面。用于咽痛、声音嘶哑、咳嗽。

zones.name: Chest lymph
zones.effect: Groove between metatarsals 1 and 2. Traditionally for chest and breast swelling.
zones.effectZh: 第1、2跖骨间缝。传统用于胸部、乳房胀痛。

zones.name: Chest & breast
zones.effect: Middle of the foot top, over metatarsals 2–4. For chest tightness.
zones.effectZh: 足背第2–4跖骨中段。用于胸闷。

zones.name: Inner ear & balance
zones.effect: Groove between metatarsals 4 and 5, near the toes. For dizziness and motion sickness.
zones.effectZh: 第4、5跖骨间缝远端。用于头晕、晕车。

zones.name: Shoulder blade
zones.effect: Over the back half of metatarsals 4 and 5. For shoulder-blade ache.
zones.effectZh: 第4、5跖骨近端1/2。用于肩胛酸痛。

zones.name: Diaphragm
zones.effect: Band across the foot top where the metatarsals meet the midfoot. For hiccups and bloating.
zones.effectZh: 足背跖骨与跗骨交界横带。用于打嗝、腹胀。

zones.name: Ribs
zones.effect: Hollows either side of the midfoot, below the diaphragm band. For rib-side ache.
zones.effectZh: 足背中部两侧，横膈膜下方。用于胁肋酸痛。

zones.name: Upper-body lymph
zones.effect: Hollow in front of the outer ankle bone. Traditionally for fever and swelling.
zones.effectZh: 外踝前凹陷。传统用于发热、肿胀。

zones.name: Lower-body lymph
zones.effect: Hollow in front of the inner ankle bone. Traditionally for leg swelling.
zones.effectZh: 内踝前凹陷。传统用于下肢水肿。

zones.name: Fallopian tubes / vas deferens
zones.effect: Band across the front of the ankle, bone to bone. Traditionally for pelvic discomfort.
zones.effectZh: 踝前横带，内外踝之间。传统用于盆腔不适。

zones.name: Xingjian (LV2)
zones.effect: Web between the big and second toes. For red eyes, headache, irritability.
zones.effectZh: 第1、2趾间趾蹼缘。用于目赤、头痛、烦躁。

zones.name: Taichong (LV3)
zones.effect: Between metatarsals 1 and 2, in the hollow before they meet. For stress, headache, high blood pressure.
zones.effectZh: 第1、2跖骨间，跖骨结合部前凹陷中。用于情志不畅、头痛、高血压。

zones.name: Neiting (ST44)
zones.effect: Web between the second and third toes. For toothache and stomach heat.
zones.effectZh: 第2、3趾间趾蹼缘。用于牙痛、胃热。

zones.name: Zulinqi (GB41)
zones.effect: Between metatarsals 4 and 5, near their base. For one-sided headache and eye pain.
zones.effectZh: 第4、5跖骨底结合部前方。用于偏头痛、目痛。

zones.name: Jiexi (ST41)
zones.effect: Front of the ankle crease, between the two tendons. For ankle pain, headache, bloating.
zones.effectZh: 踝关节前横纹中点，两筋之间。用于踝痛、头痛、腹胀。
